caveats: Covers NIST IA-5, IA-5(1), IA-5(2), IA-5(6), IA-5(7), SC-12, SC-13, SC-17, SC-28 credential rotation, password policy enforcement, SSH/PKI key rotation, and AES-256 encrypted credential storage.

account_id.meaning: Unique identifier of the managed account or service credential in Securden PAM.
account_id.shows: Which privileged or non-privileged account owns the credential rotation record.

privileged.meaning: Whether the managed account is classified as a privileged account.
privileged.shows: Scope filter distinguishing privileged accounts from regular accounts.

last_rotated_at.meaning: UTC timestamp when the account password, secret, or SSH key was last rotated.
last_rotated_at.shows: Whether credentials were rotated within the required maximum age in days (or null if never rotated).

last_rotation_status.meaning: Outcome of the most recent automated or on-demand credential rotation attempt.
last_rotation_status.shows: SUCCESS when password/key rotation succeeded; FAILED when rotation failed or is non-compliant.

caveats: Covers NIST AC-2, AC-2(1), AC-2(2), AC-2(3), AC-6, IA-4, CM-8 privileged account inventory, automated discovery, active/disabled status, and dormant account tracking.

account_id.meaning: Unique identifier of the account in Securden PAM.
account_id.shows: Which account record is being evaluated for lifecycle, dormancy, or enabled status.

privileged.meaning: Whether the account holds privileged or administrative access rights.

enabled.meaning: Whether the account is currently active and enabled for use in Securden PAM.
enabled.shows: False when an inactive, expired, or unauthorized account has been disabled; true when active.

created_at.meaning: UTC timestamp when the account was onboarded or created in Securden PAM.
created_at.shows: Account onboarding age and reporting period inclusion.

last_used_at.meaning: UTC timestamp when the account was last accessed or used for a session or checkout.
last_used_at.shows: Dormancy duration in days since last use (or null if never used since onboarding).

caveats: Covers NIST AC-17, AC-17(1), AC-17(2), AC-17(3), AC-17(4), AU-14, SC-7, SC-8 brokered remote sessions, session recording, live shadowing, and session termination.

session_id.meaning: Unique identifier of the privileged remote session launched through Securden PAM.
session_id.shows: Which interactive RDP, SSH, database, or web session is being evaluated.

account_id.meaning: Identifier of the target privileged account used during the session.
account_id.shows: Which managed account was accessed in the session.

user_id.meaning: Identifier of the PAM user who initiated the privileged session.
user_id.shows: Individual accountability for the privileged session.

started_at.meaning: UTC timestamp when the privileged session started.
started_at.shows: When the session occurred within the reporting period.

ended_at.meaning: UTC timestamp when the privileged session terminated.
ended_at.shows: Whether the session has been properly terminated (non-null) or remains open (null).

recording_required.meaning: Whether session recording is mandated by policy for this privileged session.
recording_required.shows: Scope filter selecting sessions that require session recording.

recording_status.meaning: Availability and completeness status of the session recording artifact.
recording_status.shows: AVAILABLE when a full recording exists; PARTIAL, MISSING, FAILED, or PROCESSING otherwise.

recording_reference.meaning: Opaque identifier referencing the stored session recording file or trail.
recording_reference.shows: Whether a verifiable recording artifact link exists (non-null) for audit playback.

caveats: Covers NIST AC-2, AC-2(4), AC-6, AC-6(1), AC-6(2), CM-3, CM-5, MA-4 request-release approval workflows, Just-in-Time privilege elevation, and ITSM ticket-validated access.

access_id.meaning: Unique identifier of the privileged access or checkout event.
access_id.shows: Which privileged access request or elevation event is being checked.

user_id.meaning: Identifier of the user requesting or exercising privileged access.
user_id.shows: Which user accessed the privileged account.

account_id.meaning: Identifier of the privileged account accessed.
account_id.shows: Which target account was requested or elevated.

accessed_at.meaning: UTC timestamp when the privileged access occurred.
accessed_at.shows: Event timestamp within the reporting period.

approval_required.meaning: Whether policy requires prior approval before granting access to this account.
approval_required.shows: Scope filter selecting access events governed by an approval workflow.

approval_status.meaning: Workflow approval state at the time privileged access was exercised.
approval_status.shows: APPROVED when authorized by an approver; PENDING, DENIED, or NONE when unapproved.

approval_id.meaning: Identifier of the approval workflow record authorizing the access.
approval_id.shows: Whether a formal approval record exists (non-null) for the access.

approved_at.meaning: UTC timestamp when the request was approved.
approved_at.shows: Whether approval was recorded within the required timeframe.

approver_id.meaning: Identifier of the designated approver who authorized the request.
approver_id.shows: Whether an accountable approver authorized the privileged access (non-null).

caveats: Covers NIST AC-2, AC-2(7), AC-3, AC-6, AC-6(5), AC-6(9), AC-6(10), CM-5 RBAC account entitlements, folder/group permissions, time-bound access validity, and authorized access enforcement.

access_id.meaning: Unique identifier of the privileged account access event.
access_id.shows: Which access event is being checked against RBAC entitlements.

user_id.meaning: Identifier of the user who performed the account access.

accessed_at.meaning: UTC timestamp when the account access occurred.
accessed_at.shows: Event timestamp within the reporting period.

entitlement_status.meaning: Authorization status of the user's entitlement to the account at the time of access.
entitlement_status.shows: AUTHORIZED when permitted by an active RBAC grant; NOT_AUTHORIZED, REVOKED, or UNKNOWN when unauthorized.

entitlement_id.meaning: Identifier of the account, folder, or role entitlement granting access.
entitlement_id.shows: Whether a specific entitlement grant record exists (non-null).

entitlement_valid_from.meaning: UTC start timestamp of a time-bound access entitlement.
entitlement_valid_from.shows: When the granted access window began.

entitlement_valid_to.meaning: UTC expiration timestamp of a temporary or time-bound access entitlement.
entitlement_valid_to.shows: Whether temporary access has an explicit expiration timestamp (non-null) and has not expired.

caveats: Covers NIST AC-7 consecutive invalid logon attempt tracking and automatic account lockout enforcement.

principal_id.meaning: Unique identifier of the user principal attempting authentication.
principal_id.shows: Which user account experienced consecutive failed logon attempts.

window_start.meaning: UTC start timestamp of the authentication observation window.
window_start.shows: Start of the failed logon measurement interval.

window_end.meaning: UTC end timestamp of the authentication observation window.
window_end.shows: Reporting period timestamp for the authentication summary record.

failed_attempts.meaning: Count of consecutive unsuccessful logon attempts recorded for the principal in the window.
failed_attempts.shows: Whether failed logon attempts stayed within the organization's maximum allowed attempts threshold.

lockout_triggered.meaning: Whether automatic account lockout was enforced after invalid logon attempts.
lockout_triggered.shows: True when the account was automatically locked upon reaching the failed logon threshold; false otherwise.

caveats: Covers NIST AC-2 (emergency/crisis usage), IR-4, CP-10 emergency break-glass access activation, mandatory justification, ticket linkage, and post-incident review.

event_id.meaning: Unique identifier of the emergency break-glass access activation event.
event_id.shows: Which emergency access event is being evaluated.

user_id.meaning: Identifier of the user who activated emergency break-glass access.
user_id.shows: Individual accountability for emergency access usage.

account_id.meaning: Identifier of the privileged account accessed via break-glass.
account_id.shows: Which account was accessed under emergency procedures.

activated_at.meaning: UTC timestamp when emergency break-glass access was activated.
activated_at.shows: When the break-glass event occurred within the reporting period.

justification_provided.meaning: Whether the user supplied a documented reason when activating break-glass access.
justification_provided.shows: True when a justification was recorded; false when break-glass was used without justification.

justification_length.meaning: Character length of the emergency access justification supplied by the user.
justification_length.shows: Whether the justification meets the minimum required character length threshold.

ticket_reference.meaning: Incident or change ticket identifier linked to the break-glass event.
ticket_reference.shows: Whether an incident or change ticket reference was recorded (non-null).

post_review_completed.meaning: Whether a post-activation audit review of the emergency access event was completed.
post_review_completed.shows: True when the break-glass event underwent mandatory post-usage review; false otherwise.

post_review_at.meaning: UTC timestamp when the post-activation review was completed.
post_review_at.shows: Whether the post-usage review occurred within the required number of days.

caveats: Covers NIST AC-5, CA-5, CA-7, PM-9 Separation of Duties (SoD) exceptions, risk acceptance waivers, approval timestamps, and expiration enforcement.

exception_id.meaning: Unique identifier of the policy or Separation of Duties (SoD) exception.
exception_id.shows: Which policy waiver or SoD exception is being evaluated.

rule_id.meaning: Identifier of the policy rule or SoD control covered by the exception.
rule_id.shows: Which control rule the exception applies to.

status.meaning: Current lifecycle status of the policy or SoD exception.
status.shows: ACTIVE when currently in force; EXPIRED or REVOKED when no longer valid.

approved_at.meaning: UTC timestamp when the policy exception was approved.
approved_at.shows: When the exception was granted within the assessment window.

expires_at.meaning: UTC timestamp when the policy exception expires.
expires_at.shows: Whether the exception is still within its approved validity window.

last_used_at.meaning: UTC timestamp when the exception was last relied upon.
last_used_at.shows: Recent usage of the policy exception.

caveats: Covers NIST AC-2(j), AC-5, AC-6(7), CA-7, PS-4, PS-5 periodic access certification campaigns, reviewer attestation decisions, and entitlement recertification.

account_id.meaning: Unique identifier of the account or entitlement item subject to periodic access review.
account_id.shows: Which account's access privileges are being reviewed.

privileged.meaning: Whether the reviewed account is a privileged account.
privileged.shows: Scope filter selecting privileged accounts for access review checks.

enabled.meaning: Whether the reviewed account is currently enabled.
enabled.shows: Whether an account with revoked review outcome has been disabled.

owner_id.meaning: Identifier of the designated owner of the account.
owner_id.shows: Whether the account has an assigned owner (non-null).

reviewer_id.meaning: Identifier of the reviewer who completed the access certification decision.
reviewer_id.shows: Whether an accountable reviewer attested to the review (non-null).

last_review_completed_at.meaning: UTC timestamp when the most recent periodic access review was completed for the account.
last_review_completed_at.shows: Whether the account's access privileges were reviewed within the required maximum review interval in days.

last_review_outcome.meaning: Attestation decision recorded by the reviewer during the latest access certification campaign.
last_review_outcome.shows: CERTIFIED when access was re-approved; REVOKED when access was disapproved and marked for removal.

caveats: Covers NIST AU-4, AU-5, AU-6, AU-9, AU-11, AU-12, SI-4 continuous audit trail collection, SIEM/Syslog export continuity, gap monitoring, and tamper-evident log integrity verification.

source_id.meaning: Unique identifier of the Securden PAM audit log source or telemetry stream.
source_id.shows: Which audit log subsystem is being checked for completeness and integrity.

coverage_start.meaning: UTC start timestamp of the audit log coverage interval.
coverage_start.shows: Beginning of the monitored audit collection window.

coverage_end.meaning: UTC end timestamp of the audit log coverage interval.
coverage_end.shows: Reporting period timestamp for the audit coverage summary.

expected_event_count.meaning: Number of audit events expected from the audit source during the interval.
expected_event_count.shows: Baseline event volume expected for complete audit capture.

received_event_count.meaning: Number of audit events actually recorded and retained from the audit source.
received_event_count.shows: Whether audit logging is actively capturing events above the required minimum count.

max_gap_seconds.meaning: Longest gap in seconds between consecutive audit health or event recordings in the period.
max_gap_seconds.shows: Whether audit collection operated continuously within the maximum allowed logging gap in seconds.

integrity_verified.meaning: Whether the audit trail passed integrity and tamper-protection verification.
integrity_verified.shows: True when audit records are intact and protected against unauthorized modification; false if integrity failed.

caveats: Covers NIST AU-2, AU-3, AU-3(1), AU-7, AU-8, AU-12, AC-6(9) structured audit records capturing event type, UTC timestamp, component location, origin IP/source, outcome, actor user ID, and target object ID.

event_id.meaning: Unique identifier of the individual audit log entry.
event_id.shows: Which audit record is being inspected for required AU-3 content elements.

occurred_at.meaning: Synchronized UTC timestamp when the audited event occurred.
occurred_at.shows: When the event occurred within the reporting period (AU-3/AU-8 timestamp requirement).

event_type.meaning: Classification identifier indicating what type of event occurred.
event_type.shows: Whether the audit record captures the type of event (non-null).

location_id.meaning: Identifier of the system component or server where the event occurred.
location_id.shows: Whether the audit record captures where the event occurred (non-null).

source_id.meaning: Identifier of the originating host, client IP address, or source of the event.
source_id.shows: Whether the audit record captures the source of the event (non-null).

outcome.meaning: Result of the audited action (SUCCESS, FAILURE, DENIED, or ERROR).
outcome.shows: Whether the audit record captures the success or failure outcome of the event (non-null).

actor_id.meaning: Identifier of the individual user or subject associated with the event.
actor_id.shows: Whether the audit record identifies the individual actor who performed the action (non-null).

target_id.meaning: Identifier of the target account, object, or entity acted upon.
target_id.shows: Whether the audit record identifies the target object or entity affected (non-null).

caveats: Covers NIST IA-2, IA-2(1), IA-2(2), IA-2(8), IA-2(12) multi-factor authentication enforcement and enrolled MFA factors across privileged and non-privileged users.

principal_id.meaning: Unique identifier of the user or account principal in Securden PAM.
principal_id.shows: Which principal's MFA configuration snapshot is being evaluated.

principal_type.meaning: Whether the principal is a USER or an ACCOUNT.
principal_type.shows: Type of principal (USER or ACCOUNT) subject to MFA enforcement.

privileged.meaning: Whether the principal holds privileged access rights in Securden PAM.
privileged.shows: Scope filter selecting privileged users or accounts.

enabled.meaning: Whether the principal is currently enabled for login.
enabled.shows: Active status of the user or account principal.

mfa_enforced.meaning: Whether multi-factor authentication (MFA) is enforced for this principal by policy.
mfa_enforced.shows: True when MFA is required for the user; false when single-factor login is permitted.

mfa_methods.meaning: List of MFA factor methods configured for the principal (totp, push, fido2, smart_card, hardware_token, sms, email_otp).
mfa_methods.shows: Which authenticators are enrolled for the principal.

captured_at.meaning: UTC timestamp when the MFA configuration snapshot was captured.
captured_at.shows: Snapshot timestamp within the reporting period.

caveats: Covers NIST IA-2, IA-2(1), IA-2(2), IA-5, IA-8, AC-17 per-access multi-factor authentication verification prior to granting privileged account or remote session access.

access_id.meaning: Unique identifier of the privileged access authentication event.
access_id.shows: Which privileged access attempt is being evaluated.

user_id.meaning: Identifier of the user authenticating for privileged access.
user_id.shows: Individual user accountability for the authentication event.

account_id.meaning: Identifier of the target privileged account being accessed.

accessed_at.meaning: UTC timestamp when the privileged access authentication occurred.
accessed_at.shows: Event timestamp within the reporting period.

access_granted.meaning: Whether privileged access was granted following the authentication check.
access_granted.shows: True when access was granted; false when access was blocked.

mfa_status.meaning: Result of multi-factor authentication verification for this privileged access event.
mfa_status.shows: VERIFIED when MFA succeeded before access; NOT_PERFORMED, FAILED, or UNKNOWN when MFA was not verified.

mfa_method.meaning: Specific MFA factor used to verify the user (totp, push, fido2, smart_card, hardware_token, sms, email_otp).
mfa_method.shows: Which multi-factor method was completed when mfa_status is VERIFIED.

caveats: Covers NIST AC-11, AC-12, SC-10 session lock, idle session timeout enforcement, and automatic termination of inactive privileged sessions.

policy_id.meaning: Unique identifier of the session timeout policy in Securden PAM.
policy_id.shows: Which session management policy snapshot is being checked.

applies_to_privileged.meaning: Whether this session policy governs privileged sessions and administrative interfaces.
applies_to_privileged.shows: Scope filter selecting session policies that apply to privileged access.

idle_timeout_enabled.meaning: Whether automatic session lock or termination upon inactivity is enabled.
idle_timeout_enabled.shows: True when idle sessions are automatically locked or terminated; false when sessions never time out.

idle_timeout_minutes.meaning: Configured inactivity timeout duration in minutes before a session is locked or terminated.
idle_timeout_minutes.shows: Whether the idle timeout duration is at most the organization's maximum allowed inactivity minutes.

captured_at.meaning: UTC timestamp when the session policy configuration snapshot was captured.
captured_at.shows: Snapshot timestamp within the reporting period.
